The Mad Scientist doesn't seem to notice you and keeps mumbling to himself...

[Mad Scientist]
Haha, no Orcs are coming near me!
The power of the Dimensional Gorge is undefeatable!!
Orcs don't attack you?
You wish!

[Mad Scientist]
Yeah, yeah.. I know it's hard to belive. I don't blame ya.
I used to study the Dimensional Gorge discovered near Morocc.
According to my research, the minerals found there have enormous power inside them!

[Mad Scientist]
You are a pretty distrustful person, huh?
Oh? Like what, travel to alternate space?

[Mad Scientist]
Very smart! I have actually just done that! See that statue over there? It's not your normal Monolith!

[Mad Scientist]
I have created it with a combination of our technology and the unlimited energy I discovered from the Gorge! Want to try it?
...Um, that doesn't sound legal?

[Mad Scientist]
Hey, since when did something so interesting have to be legal!? How about it! You can talk to the Orcs! C'mon!

[Mad Scientist]
Chances are they'll just give you lots of instructions once they see you, so just wing it! They're always saying the same thing, to the point where I memorized them!
Alright... What do I do?
Umm, maybe not.

[Mad Scientist]
Very good! Just sit in the hands of this statue! And try to act natural when you're in there!

[Mad Scientist]
Oh fine, be that way!

[Mad Scientist]
Hmm? Put your hand on that Monemus Statue if you want to experience traveling through dimensions!

[Kruger]
*Coughing*
{0}, it's you...

[{0}] 
Don't move! You are wounded!

[Kruger]
It's... all right.. I'm dying...
....
The Shaman? What about the Shaman?

[{0}] 
The Shaman's dead now. Who was that Shaman really?
Kruger seemed to be relieved as he hears of the death of the Shaman, but you notice the bitter expression on his face.

[Kruger]
I.. I just couldn't kill my own daughter...
Thank you, I'm sure she's finally free from the nightmare that used to choke her soul.
Kruger was about to say something more, but he breathed his last breath before he could...
You can see the dead body of Kruger, peacefully lying on the ground.
